name: Lugaidh Riab nDerg

attributes.attribute: son of Clothra, sister of Medb
son of three brothers at once
wore three red stripes that marked his fathers

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lugaidh Riab nDerg was an Irish hero whose name means Lugaidh of the Red Stripes. He was the son of Clothra, the sister of the queen-goddess Medb. Three brothers lay with Clothra at the same time, and Lugaidh was said to be the son of all three at once. Three red stripes crossed his body, and each stripe marked the part of him fathered by one brother.

okr.objective: Document Lugaidh Riab nDerg, the hero with the three red stripes.
